notes: Posted Objective 'There Is Good In Him / I Will Exploit It' (wrong back side) dested There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him.

Starting cards as posted under 'Other Starting (non-purple) (9)': Luke Skywalker, Rebel Scout, his Lightsaber, I Feel The Conflict, Heading For The Medical Frigate ('Heady MF'), Staging Areas, Insurrection, Strike Planning, Endor: Chief Chirpa's Hut ('Chirpa's Pad') and Endor: Landing Platform; the strategy says to start Wise Advice instead of Staging Areas against SAC. Several Effects start, so starting.effect is empty. Total 60 as published; section headers ('Purple', 'Red Stuff (27)' etc.) are labels.

'Moff Wedge' matches no card (Wedge Antilles, Commander Wedge Antilles and Wedge Antilles, Red Squadron Leader all possible) and 'Grabber' could be either Light grabber of the time (What're You Tryin' To Push On Us? or Grappling Hook): both shown as posted and marked UNKNOWN.

Posted location ' DB' lost its spaceport symbol (the strategy says 'Use your <> DB'): dested Spaceport Docking Bay. 'Homey DB' Home One: Docking Bay; 'Echo DB' Hoth: Echo Docking Bay; 'His Saber' Luke's Lightsaber.

Posted 'Squassin' dested Squadron Assignments; 'Insight' Your Insight Serves You Well; 'OOC/TT' Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated; 'Shocking Info' Shocking Information; 'R2 in Red 5' Artoo-Detoo In Red 5; 'Obi w/Saber' Obi-Wan With Lightsaber; 'Leia w/Gun' Leia With Blaster Rifle.
The post says the deck was played 'through 5 or 6 tournaments' (none named); filed as a general list.
